name: agent-handbook
description: A handbook you hand to your agent: material for the general judgement calls — architecture decisions, planning, the rules that hold whatever is being built. Nothing here is tied to a language, a stack or a framework, and nothing installs a runtime, calls a network or needs hardware. It holds two kinds of thing: an instrument you reach for at a moment — `/target-world-walk`, which derives what a plan needs by replaying one concrete unit of work through the system you intend to have — and a standing rule that is never invoked at all, the flagellant rule, which reports a mistake as fact plus fix rather than apology, stops when the stopping condition is met instead of re-checking finished work, and spends care where an error cannot be taken back. The standing rule arrives through a SessionStart hook, so it composes with whatever output style you have chosen rather than replacing it.
